prior_credit: The arrival enquiry and return enquiry were already read at p174 B/C in the Seifert service edition. p183 B already supplied complementary raw source support for the p174 B mask. Published period key: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017). Additional p182 physical witnesses, source alignment and explicit costs: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. No new-word or first-decipherment priority is asserted.
limits: Native55/49-slot source transcriptions are retained in full, including the seven non-coordinate A glyphs and final C X.
The74-slot A model excludes one printed slot and inserts20, so the net nineteen-slot shortfall does not hide a structural operation.

A has eleven equal minima for observed substitutions: four exclude a masked glyph and fill six remaining printed masks; seven exclude an observed D and fill seven printed masks. Every branch adds and fills20 separately identified model slots.
The48-slot C model does not follow its printed56 header. One observed X exclusion and one F-to-V substitution are explicitly conditional on its independently observed p174C parallel.

The bounded frame comparisons use independent raw source coordinates rather than a German language score. They do not establish a unique physical error mechanism or a unique geometry outside the tested model classes.
No numerical label, abbreviated signature, personal identity or itinerary is inferred from shared vocabulary.
